articles.title: Maya Protocol exploit drains bitcoin and other assets as pool value drops by $11 million
articles.snippet: A chain of six flaws caused the cross-chain trading network to credit a pool with nearly 50 million tokens that were never properly funded, letting an attacker drain real assets.

articles.title: Hackers Are Abusing a macOS Screen Sharing Flaw to Secretly Mine Monero
articles.snippet: The Dutch cyber agency says attackers exploited an authentication flaw in macOS Screen Sharing to gain root access and plant Monero miners, with public proof-of-concept code now circulating.
